caseNameFull: Immigration and Naturalization Service v. Stanisic

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 912.] Motion of respondent for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that G. Bernhard Fedde, Esquire, of Portland, Oregon, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
